column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3:
The desert keeps its dead,
Isaac. The sand covers
every trace.{page_break}You came too late.
I watched it happen.{end_wait}

You still think a kind
word can put everything
back where it was.{page_break}Look around you, Isaac.
Some things stay broken.{end_wait}
Keep following them.\nYou'll learn what it\ncosts to be too late.{end_wait}
